cohort: Pregnant women undergoing uncomplicated delivery (vaginal or cesarean) at Yas Hospital Complex, Tehran, Iran
finding: Endometrial thickness at 24 hours postpartum was significantly greater after vaginal delivery compared to cesarean section, and there was a significant inverse correlation between endometrial thickness and gestational age.
mod_finding: Endometrial thickness at 24 hours postpartum was significantly greater after vaginal delivery compared to cesarean section.
